title: How to Debug Like a Pro
intro: Debugging is a skill you can learn. This process works for almost any bug.

slides.heading: Read the error
slides.subtitle: It often tells you exactly what's wrong.
points: Read the whole message, not just the first line
The stack trace shows where it happened
Find the first line from your own code

slides.heading: Reproduce it
slides.subtitle: Make it happen on demand.
points: Find the exact steps that trigger it
Shrink it to the smallest failing case
A bug you can reproduce is half fixed

slides.heading: Use your tools
slides.subtitle: Stop guessing, start looking.
points: Set breakpoints in DevTools or your editor
Check the Network tab for failed requests

slides.heading: Search smart
slides.subtitle: Someone has probably seen it before.
points: Check the official docs and GitHub issues
Explain the problem out loud, step by step

scenario.situation: Your app crashes with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'map')".
scenario.problem: You start changing random code, hoping the error goes away.
scenario.fix: The stack trace points to your line. Logging the value shows the API returned nothing. Fix: (data ?? []).map(...).
scenario.takeaway: Read the error, find the line, check the value.

cta: What's the longest you've spent on a single bug?
